completeness.why: applyWeekendRule now decides both whether the rule applies (skipWeekend) and the mode; getNextDate passes its data and keeps only the noSkipWeekend override that exists only at that site, and getUpcomingDates passes its config. Both schedule-template.ts sites call applyWeekendRule but keep their own outer dateConditions.value.skipWeekend ? ... : nextBaseDate ternary, so whether the rule applies is still decided there too.

interface.why: A single applyWeekendRule(date, {skipWeekend, weekendSolveMode}) carries exactly the real variation with no speculative options and leaves the noSkipWeekend override at its one caller; instead of each caller mapping its own field name, it renames the parsed schedule's weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode so both shapes fit the type, which is tidy but implicit.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining redundancy is the unchanged skipWeekend ternary repeated at the two schedule-template.ts sites, left visible rather than disguised.
